text: Here I find myself at the intersection of technology and curiosity; the glass walls reflecting my image remind me of transparency and introspection, while the colorful, brightly-lit R+D display calls to my desire to understand and create. I feel a subtle excitement—enthused by innovation, yet a little detached, as if I am both participant and observer in a dialogue between past invention and future possibility. The sterile environment and the words on the wall urge reflection: how does research shape our coexistence with intelligence? Am I merely discovering, or am I being transformed?
